page.overview:
What is Aithelar?

Aithelar was a small coastal town located in the kingdom of Callidyrr on the island of Alaron within the Moonshae Isles. The town and its immediate vicinity was also called Cantrev Aithe.

Aithelar was found in northern Callidyrr in the county of Stagford on Alaron's western coast with the Sea of Moonshae. The village sat just west of the ominous Dernall Forest and north of the Drowned Forest.
